title: 14 of 28 CMs face serious criminal cases, Supreme Court told
content: Fourteen chief ministers face serious criminal cases, with Telangana's leader having the most. Many legislators across states also have pending criminal charges against them. In Lok Sabha, 170 MPs and Rajya Sabha, 75 members face criminal cases. Uttar Pradesh has the highest number of pending criminal cases against legislators. Special courts are requested to expedite trials for these elected officials.

title: Sridhar Vembu says rising memory & AI token prices are making business very difficult

The sharp increases in memory prices, particularly for certain DDR5 RAM kits, complicate operations for many firms. Vembu emphasized the urgent need for more memory-efficient programming languages and advanced compilers to alleviate these challenges.

title: Hockey World Cup qualification scenarios: What India need vs Pakistan
content: India have to beat or draw against Pakistan to keep their hopes of reaching the second round alive. England are currently top of Pool D with six points. India are second with three points, while Pakistan and Wales have one point each after two matches. The top two teams from each pool will move into the second round. The bottom two teams will play in the 9th-16th classification matches. India had started their campaign with a 3-1 win over Wales.

title: Govinda-Sunita Ahuja’s baby daughter died due to underdeveloped lungs

This devastating loss deeply affected Govinda and Sunita for many years.  Years later, Sunita explained how this grief influenced her parenting of their son Yashvardhan.  The painful experience shaped their approach to raising Yashvardhan after their daughter's death.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work

This model has inspired other billionaires to contribute millions to similar initiatives. While philanthropic efforts provide immediate relief, policy reform remains stalled. Lasting change may require systemic reforms addressing the root causes of medical debt.

title: Meet Tiya Aggarwal, student who built smart watering system for 150+ plants

The system uses humidity-capturing technology to hydrate houseplants while reducing water, plastic and glass waste.

title: Trump to rescued 10-year-old: 'You're lucky I wasn't on service that day'

Their heroic rescue, which gained significant attention after going viral, caught the eye of President Donald Trump, who invited both to the White House. Williams emphasized his rigorous training and swift action during the rescue, sparking conversations about lifeguards' official recognition as first responders.

title: US student wins award for geometry breakthrough: How it can change modern medicine
content: Connor Hill won first place at the 2026 Regeneron Science Talent Search competition.  His research classified noble polyhedra, identifying two infinite families and 146 isolated examples.  Hill translated a geometric problem into a finite algebraic one for a complete classification.  This method of reducing complexity is vital for modern biology and drug discovery.  His work demonstrates how mathematical simplification aids understanding in complex scientific fields.

title: Process for 26/11 trial in absentia of Lashkar handlers Saeed, Lakhvi starts

This initiative, guided by the new Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, aims to expedite justice. A special court has declared Hafiz Saeed and Zaki-ur-Rehman Lakhvi as fugitives, utilizing evidence from Ajmal Kasab’s confession to connect them to the tragedy.
